title: Air National Guardsmen Hurricane Florence Rescue
description: Coast to coast, New York to California, Kentucky, Alaska, Oregon… around the world, the Air National Guard is always there, always ready to respond for those in needs. This amazing Task Force of Rescue Warriors made a total of 19 saves today in North Carolina. This entire team of approximately 180 Air National Guardsmen from world class maintainers to loggies, intel, weather, communications, pilots, aircrew, guardian angel and more from every rescue team in the Air National Guard banded together to create a highly experienced and effective response force gathered to do the mission here at Oceana Naval Air Station, V.A.,  Sept. 17, 2018. The Air National Guardsmen are offering up support to civil authorities as needed in response to hurricane relief operations. These things we do that others may live!
